name: Mac Trackpad
author: 2strange
description: Mac-like settings for the built-in trackpad, in the bar: natural scrolling, tracking and scroll speed, tap to click, two-finger right click, ignore while typing, applied live. No daemon: it writes ~/.config/hypr/trackpad.lua and one marked loader block in input.lua. Its own three-finger workspace swipe works from workspace 1, can keep empty workspaces 1-5, and at the end stops, opens a new one or wraps around. MagicMouse's two-finger swipe uses this same gesture (Fingers: 3).

barWidget.description: Click for trackpad settings; every control applies live through hypr/trackpad.lua
